2. CHECK ADHESIVE'S USABLE TIME
After mixing main and hardening agents, finish glass installation within the specified time as shown.
Example: For glass installation in an ambient temperature of 25°C (77°F), apply adhesive set No.35 within 45 minutes.

3. CHECK ADHESIVE HARDENING TIME
After main and hardening agents are mixed, leak tests should be made only after the hardening time has elapsed.
Example: The hardening time for adhesive set No.35 in an ambient temperature of 25°C (77°F) is 2 and 1/2 hours.
NOTICE: Do not drive the vehicle until at least double the hardening time has elapsed.
